cases.name: clickable
cases.when: onClick is set and actionsEnabled is false or absent -- the chip root itself renders as <button>

cases.name: clickable-with-actions
cases.when: onClick is set and actionsEnabled is true -- a kebab cannot nest inside a button, so the root becomes a <div> and the interactive attributes move down to the chip BODY, a descendant <button>

cases.name: inert
cases.when: onClick is absent, regardless of actionsEnabled -- nothing obliges a consumer to pass onClick
cases.reason: With no onClick the chip is a <div> with no role, no tabbable behaviour and no activation. This is true whether or not actionsEnabled renders a kebab beside it -- the kebab is its own IconButton with its own accessible name and is not the subject of this binding -- so this whole pattern does not apply to the chip itself in this shape.
